I see the bug now: LinearSearch3's requires clause allows |s1| to equal data.Length+1, which then causes an out-of-range index when accessing data[data.Length-1-i] in the loop. The fix is tightening the requires to |s1| <= data.Length rather than +1.

Deciding which proof obligation label fits is messier -- the failures span loop body line 90 and post-loop asserts at 93, 95, 105, but since the root cause traces back to the weak precondition, I'll classify this as an initiation issue.
